text:
You don't have a hobby. You have an excuse.

A girl asks what you do for fun. You say work. Something dies in her eyes.

You're not boring because you work. You're boring because you have nothing else. She can smell it.

A hobby signals you have a life worth being part of. Surfing. DJing. Martial arts. Rock climbing. It proves you build and create.

Without it, you're invisible.

Pick one. Do it badly. The act signals everything.

Nothing built, nothing attracts. Something built, something attracts.
caption:
The difference between boring and interesting isn't money or looks. It's whether you actually build something.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
